title: Codex review verdict
description: Structured output contract for a read-only, worktree-bound Codex milestone or plan review. The wrapper (scripts/run_codex_review.py) passes this schema to `codex exec --output-schema` and then re-validates the result locally against the same invariants. Approval is accepted only from a schema-valid, target-matched verdict with no blocking findings.

verdict.description: approve only when no material blocking finding remains for this target.

summary.description: One to three sentence summary of the reviewed change and the verdict rationale.

target.description: The exact target this verdict covers. The wrapper rejects a verdict whose target does not match the bound worktree, scope, and baseline.

repository.description: Absolute path to the reviewed repository (git toplevel).

worktree.description: Absolute path to the exact worktree reviewed.

scope.description: The review scope selector that was used.

baseline.description: The baseline reference (branch for base scope, commit sha for commit scope, or the HEAD sha for uncommitted scope).

target_ref.description: Optional further target identity, e.g. the target commit sha or dirty-state digest.

findings.description: Material findings. An approve verdict must contain no critical or high severity finding. Zero findings is valid only with verdict approve.

id.description: Stable finding identifier unique within this verdict, e.g. F-1, F-auth-leak.

file.description: Repository-relative path when the finding is localized.

line.description: Line number or range string (e.g. 42 or '42-58') when applicable.

evidence.description: Concrete repository evidence or a minimal counterexample that substantiates the finding.

affected_behavior.description: The observable behavior, invariant, or flow that is affected.

recommendation.description: The smallest concrete correction that addresses the root cause.

next_steps.description: What should happen next: for approve, the milestone may advance; for needs-attention, the accepted findings should be corrected and the review re-run.
